Indications for Use (Describe)
The Codman Hakim Precision Fixed Pressure Valve Systems are implantable devices that provide constant
intraventricular pressure and drainage of cerebral spinal fluid (CSF) for the management of hydrocephalus.
The Codman Hakim Programmable Valves Systems are implantable devices that provide constant intraventricular
pressure and drainage of cerebral spinal fluid (CSF) for the management of hydrocephalus.
